description: First campaign (draft). The five first-batch servers on every eligible corpus pair. Per (server, project): r0_crash 1 seed; r1_history 3 settled seeds + 1 race0 + 1 race200 seed; r2-r5 2 seeds each; r6 2 seeds on ts7 with ts6 as the reference. Concurrency, per-run timeout and the wall-clock budget are to be fixed from the dry-run timings.

force.reason: the corpus probe did not settle because of a URI-encoding bug in the probe; the engine settles this pair in 5 s

rust-lang/rustlings.reason: exercise and solution files belong to no crate (rust-analyzer offers no IDE services there); as in the R2/R3/R5 pilot

notes: race0 and race200 use seed 1, the seed of the first settled run: same targets and histories, different timing, so that timing-only violations can be told apart.
r3_routes, r6_crossimpl and r0_crash do not use max_cases (they check every target).
server_limits: at most 2 rust-analyzer runs at a time (a session takes up to 3.5 GB; R1 runs two side by side).

Cost controls (campaign_costs.py): candidates with a registered legitimate-difference label (r3_routes definitionConsistency.signature / .shorthand) are recorded as labelled-legitimate without replay; a signature confirmed in 3 runs is capped (later candidates recorded as capped, not replayed).
Draft: the final budget is decided from the dry run (data/lsptest/runs/dryrun).
